reviews.t: knowing it's bad for my hair
reviews.x: I've never tried these before and I'm always using flat irons, knowing it's bad for my hair. Listen...I use these overnight, sometimes for a few hours..I take them out and it looks as if I used the world's most PERFECT curler. These are my favorite things to use. Love em.

reviews.t: These Fun Rods Will Deliver Curls
reviews.x: I've used these flexible curling rods several times now.  First, I practiced wrapping my hair up a few times at home without waiting the required time to get the curls.  (I was so excited to try it out when they arrived.) I also tried it with both wet and dry hair.  The hair wrapping goes pretty quickly because there are no fasteners or clips to worry about.  That was a key factor in my decision to try these. You just roll up the hair from the bottom up and then bend the long ends up over the cu

reviews.t: Five Stars
reviews.x: Great for quick curling without a curling iron. Love this product perfect for any hair type.

reviews.t: Nice, but cheaply made.
reviews.x: These are ok, just ok. These pictures show being in my daughters hair for only 15 minutes. I didn't want super curly but just a beach wave. Without the heat especially since she's little. She loves styling her hair different so I thought these would be perfect for her. It would have gotten 5 stars but the white plastic caps came off the ends of some when arrived and also when using and the metal is coming out... the white end caps are only tied on with a string. Also, the hairs do get caught on

reviews.t: Beautiful curls in 10min!
reviews.x: These are just ammmmazing. Life changing product!

reviews.t: Curly Hair
reviews.x: These flexi-rods are essentially the same as those that you would purchase at your local beauty supply store.  The thing I like about the Ohuhu pack is that you have seven varying sizes and colors.  There are six of each size.  It also comes with the storage bag, as shown, which is great for storage and if you need to travel with them.  They run about $13, as of the date of this review.  The price isn't bad at all.  These are great if you want spiral curls or to add curls to the ends of your hai

reviews.t: Fun, lasting curls
reviews.x: These are awesome for the price! My daughter could actually sleep in these, they are squishy enough. I tried the smaller sizes first and her hair was extremely curly for the whole day. Normally her smooth, fine hair won't hold a curl for more than an hour. I'm excited to try the larger sizes and hopefully get a looser curl for a different look.

reviews.t: Pretty cool
reviews.x: They worked for my hair! I guess depending on how tight or which way you roll them depends on the type of curl you'll get. I'm definitely going to use them on my daughters hair.

reviews.t: Great Product for Varying Styles
reviews.x: I have tried many types of hair rollers over the years and these are definitely one of the best I have used. They are easy to use and not uncomfortable, even for sleeping, as many types are. These twist-flex rods also make it simple to achieve different type curls and work for all lengths and types of hair. I have used them myself and for my granddaughter to style our hair and we have both been pleased with the results. It is nice to find a product that works this well. Thank you.

reviews.t: Easy to use for the clueless!
reviews.x: I just ordered these and tried for the first time. I am absolutely CLUELESS about all things beauty, so did these on a whim last night and woke up with some great curls! I keep getting compliments at work too. Sleeping in them wasn't super comfortable, but I'm surE I'll get used to it. Thankfully they're soft, so it's not terrible. They didn't stay in very well, but again, still woke up with great curls.

reviews.t: I love them.
reviews.x: I got a curl setting product to work with the twist flex rods and now get pretty curls that relax during the day. I put the curler by my scalp and wrap the hair around it then finish by putting the hair ends toward my scalp and turn the curler with hair closer to my scalp, made a loop of the twist flex (one half  over the other) then bent that loop forward over the curls then brought the twist ends around the hair & loop to make a tight knot by my scalp.  Try to get them toward the top of my hea

reviews.t: Works - can't speak to durability
reviews.x: Instructions insufficient for the newbie - had to watch internet video to get the hair to stay on, but I probably could have figured it out with patience (I really don't do anything with my hair normally).  Not really sure they are an improvement over regular curlers with sleeves though!  First use had trouble getting curls close to the scalp, but was able to achieve a wave in just a couple of hours of wear from dry hair (fine, straight caucasian hair), although it didn't hold up to being brushe

reviews.t: Don't be so quick to give up!
reviews.x: My first time buying foam rollers was from Walmart, a pack of 18 conair rollers that came in 2 sizes for $15.. I was pretty disappointed when I saw this pack of 42 for $13 on amazon a few weeks after.  First, the sturdiness of these rods differ from the Conair ones I had purchased. They felt less firm, but found as you go down in size that changes. This can affect how well it stays in your hair, but I just use an elastic on the bottom part to keep my ends rolled. Second, I have long hair so I fo

reviews.t: Great for Natural Looking Curls without damaging heat
reviews.x: These curlers are great! They are easy on the hair, no snagging or tangling. I wash my hair and dry it almost completely. Then, divide my hair into sections and start at the ends and roll my hair up as far as I can. A simple bend of the roller holds the hair in place. I repeat with each section. Once dry, unroll and enjoy very natural looking curls. These are so much better than using curling irons or heated rollers that dry and damage hair. I highly recommend these curlers.

reviews.t: First curlers that have ever worked on my LONG HAIR
reviews.x: My hair is really long (down to my mid thigh when it is completely straight) and I never was able to get a good curl I actually liked. With THIS, some gel, and 6 hours overnight- It was my FIRST full head of curls I did that I actually liked the result!!!!! All the other curls I've attempted loosened up right away because of the how much hair was on the curler or took way to long and I had to give up. I'm sure with a few more uses I'll get better at it too. :)

reviews.t: Sorry but these don't work
reviews.x: I was hoping for a way to add curl to my hair without using heat.  These are very slick and don't grab your hair at all. And when you get your hair wrapped around it and try to twist the roller to stay in place, they often fall down or out completely because of their weight. Plus they don't twist easily. They are too thick to hold up with bobby pins to keep them from falling. Essentially this was a waste of $$.

reviews.t: Best Curler Set Ever!!!!
reviews.x: I love all the different different sized rollers included in this set. It's great for any size curl that I'm trying to achieve. Works best if you curl your hair while still damp and let it set until dry, then take them out. Then you better watch out for all the curls you are going to get. And those curls will last for days and days if you don't brush them all out.

reviews.t: So far great! My hair is already curly so I cant ...
reviews.x: So far great! My hair is already curly so I cant really say how it will work with someone with straight hair, but for me it keeps my curls in tact. That is pretty much what I wanted them. Like any curlers, the longer you leave them the more defined they'll be.

reviews.t: These are great!! Really curled my hair and my two ...
reviews.x: These are great!! Really curled my hair and my two year olds hair!!! I wanted something that wasnt going to damage her hair and these are PERFECT!! we slept with them in over night didnt bother either one of us!! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

reviews.t: These so-called Flex Curlers actually Un-Flex
reviews.x: I had already purchased some (other brand) of the thinner size of 'flex stick rollers' and they had worked great so I thought it would be good to have the Ohuhu set since it contained many different thicknesses. I tried the Ohuhu rollers immediately and realized that only the thinnest sizes of their rollers actually work.  The 4 thickest sizes will not hold a 'bend' at all.  Those immediately unfold and there goes your hair!  Also, for me anyway, all of these curlers rollers are much too long.

reviews.t: I recommend. There are small parts inside the rollers so ...
reviews.x: Well, I actually gave these to my 2 year old to play with - as long as you are watching, I recommend. There are small parts inside the rollers so make sure you don't leave the child alone with these, but this is such a fun way for them to play! My baby was amazed with the colors, and the shapes she was able to make herself - and she kept playing for over 20 minutes with them - I think more than she usually plays with most of the toys. These are super colorful, and there are so many of them in th

reviews.t: Twisty Rods for Beachy Waves or Coily Curls
reviews.x: My hair has lots of different kinds of curls in it, from tight coils near the nape of my neck, to spirals, all the way to slightly wavy hair at the crown of my head.  I get a more consistent curl when I use curlers!  I've been using large foam curlers for a while to get large, uniform waves that straighten out over a few days, but I wanted to try a curler that would give me tighter curls.  The Ohuhu Twist Flex Rods come with 7 different curl sizes, and each size has 6 rollers.  The rollers are c

reviews.t: Never burning my hair again.
reviews.x: These work perfectly. I have waist length hair and I still have plenty of length to the rod left over. I don't use hair product when using these so they look a bit more natural. I can have them in for about an hour and I'm good to go. Of course the amount of time you keep them in affects the curls so that's all up to you. They're very flexible so you can tie them in just about any way. I love using the smaller rods for tighter curls.

reviews.t: All of the colors except the two biggest ones stay twisted just fine. Some reviews made it seem like it's hard ...
reviews.x: I read some complaints about them not staying twisted. All of the colors except the two biggest ones stay twisted just fine. Some reviews made it seem like it's hard to do, but it isn't hard at all. The two biggest ones stay in best if you tie it in a knot.  The curls are BEAUTIFUL! I love to curl my hair but I hate damaging it with heat. These are perfect.

reviews.t: I like them, I bought two sets
reviews.x: I like them, I bought two sets, my hair is fine and the first time I used the smaller rollers, I had to put some water on my hands to loosen the curl. That is why I bought a second set to use the yellow and blue ones. I do hate that the packaging because the zipper is very cheap and does not work right, but I love the larger rollers...

claims.text: Customers frequently praise these rods for producing beautiful, long-lasting curls, often without heat.
Many reviewers find the rods easy to use and effective even for beginners or those clueless about styling.
Several customers say the rods are comfortable enough to sleep in overnight.
Some reviewers note the rods feel cheaply made or less sturdy than other brands.
A few customers mention that instructions are insufficient and they had to look up videos or practice to get the hang of wrapping.
